data.one_liner: A customizable ruler-style number picker widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: SimpleRulerPicker provides a scrollable ruler-like interface allowing users to select a numeric value between a minimum and maximum range. It supports customizable line heights, scale spacing, colors, and both horizontal and vertical axis orientations.
use_when: You need a visually appealing number selection widget resembling a physical ruler.
Users need to scroll through a continuous numeric range like height, weight, or age inputs.
avoid_when: You require standard text-field numeric inputs or dropdown spinners.
You need complex date or time picking rather than a simple continuous scalar value.
strengths: Highly customizable scale elements, line heights, strokes, and colors.
Supports both horizontal and vertical orientations.
weaknesses: Limited to integer value selections within a fixed range.
Only provides basic ruler styling out-of-the-box.
